@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：照片邊緣或反光處，個別字詞可能有誤。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The volunteers d______e their time to taking care of stray animals.
= dedicate
~詞義 dedicate（v.）致力於;奉獻
~原文 The volunteers dedicate their time to taking care of stray animals.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The amoeba is a single-celled o______m, and it is so small that it can't be seen with the naked eye.
= organism
~詞義 organism（n.）有機體
~原文 The amoeba is a single-celled organism, and it is so small that it can't be seen with the naked eye.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tom chose a book at r______m from the shelf and ended up enjoying it more than he had expected.
= random
~詞義 random（n.）隨機地(at random)
~原文 Tom chose a book at random from the shelf and ended up enjoying it more than he had expected.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Melody broke her right leg and had to use a w______r for two months.
= wheelchair
~詞義 wheelchair（n.）輪椅
~原文 Melody broke her right leg and had to use a wheelchair for two months.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The restaurant owner installed a water f______r on every tap in his kitchen. He cares a lot about the quality of the water he serves.
= filter
~詞義 filter（n.）濾器
~原文 The restaurant owner installed a water filter on every tap in his kitchen. He cares a lot about the quality of the water he serves.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The famous actor finally ______ to the interview after receiving reassurance about the questions.
A: suspended
B: worshiped
C: consented
D: schemed
= C
~詞義 consent（v.）同意
~原文 The famous actor finally consented to the interview after receiving reassurance about the questions.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Linda is on a diet, so she asked her friends not to ______ her with any desserts or soft drinks.
A: dissolve
B: pedal
C: generate
D: tempt
= D
~詞義 tempt（v.）引誘
~原文 Linda is on a diet, so she asked her friends not to tempt her with any desserts or soft drinks.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many ______ organizations are established for the purpose of promoting environmental protection.
A: transparent
B: nonprofit
C: neutral
D: crucial
= B
~詞義 nonprofit（adj.）非營利的
~原文 Many nonprofit organizations are established for the purpose of promoting environmental protection.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is recommended that you back up the data stored in your computer before you ______ its system. That way, if anything goes wrong, you can still access your old files.
A: update
B: yield
C: provoke
D: manifest
= A
~詞義 update（v.）更新
~原文 It is recommended that you back up the data stored in your computer before you update its system. That way, if anything goes wrong, you can still access your old files.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In order to recover quickly, the patient needs to get enough rest and ______.
A: burial
B: nutrition
C: temptation
D: terminal
= B
~詞義 nutrition（n.）營養
~原文 In order to recover quickly, the patient needs to get enough rest and nutrition.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: intent
B: chef
C: commission
D: vague
E: vacuum
F: recession

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The museum decided to ______ a famous artist to create a sculpture for its new outdoor garden.
= C
~詞義 commission（v.）委任製作
~原文 The museum decided to commission a famous artist to create a sculpture for its new outdoor garden.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: When you want to describe something, you should use precise language rather than ______ and flat vocabulary.
= D
~詞義 vague（adj.）模糊的
~原文 When you want to describe something, you should use precise language rather than vague and flat vocabulary.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Cathy was ______ on improving her grades and spent every evening reviewing her notes.
= A
~詞義 intent（adj.）一心一意的
~原文 Cathy was intent on improving her grades and spent every evening reviewing her notes.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Economists have predicted that the weak market will go into a period of ______ very soon.
= F
~詞義 recession（n.）衰退
~原文 Economists have predicted that the weak market will go into a period of recession very soon.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tina's dog sheds a lot of hair, so she has to ______ her room at least twice a week.
= E
~詞義 vacuum（v.）用吸塵器清掃
~原文 Tina's dog sheds a lot of hair, so she has to vacuum her room at least twice a week.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: rear
B: generator
C: confession
D: loop
E: ultimate
F: nutrient

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The criminal tried to sneak out of the building through its ______ entrance, but the police were waiting there for him.
= A
~詞義 rear（adj.）後面的
~原文 The criminal tried to sneak out of the building through its rear entrance, but the police were waiting there for him.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The manager has the power to make the ______ decision, but he always listens to everyone's opinions before giving his final say.
= E
~詞義 ultimate（adj.）最終的
~原文 The manager has the power to make the ultimate decision, but he always listens to everyone's opinions before giving his final say.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The apartment building has its own electricity ______; even in an emergency blackout, it can provide power for the residents.
= B
~詞義 generator（n.）發電機
~原文 The apartment building has its own electricity generator; even in an emergency blackout, it can provide power for the residents.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: A: "I have a(n) ______ to make: I forgot your birthday." B: "That's okay."
= C
~詞義 confession（n.）坦承
~原文 A: "I have a(n) confession to make: I forgot your birthday." B: "That's okay."

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Carol likes to put her favorite song on a(n) ______ and listen to it again and again while she works. She never gets tired of that song.
= D
~詞義 loop（n.）循環;環路
~原文 Carol likes to put her favorite song on a(n) loop and listen to it again and again while she works. She never gets tired of that song.
